process_description: CANONICAL overview of all legal trails. Returns summary counts for each category. CANONICAL log a new violation. Creates a violation record with type, perpetrator, and date. CANONICAL list violations with optional filters. Returns violations sorted by date. CANONICAL get a specific violation by ID. Returns full violation details. CANONICAL log an eviction threat. Creates a record of the threat with date and details. CANONICAL list all eviction threats. Returns threats sorted by date. CANONICAL log a late fee violation. Records the overcharge amount and details. CANONICAL list all late fee violations. Returns violations with total overcharged amount. CANONICAL calculate the legal maximum late fee for a given rent amount and days late. CANONICAL add a broker to track for oversight accountability. CANONICAL list all brokers being tracked for oversight. CANONICAL get broker oversight details by broker name. CANONICAL link a violation to a broker's oversight record. CANONICAL create a formal legal claim. Returns the new claim with ID. CANONICAL list all legal claims with optional status filter. CANONICAL get a specific legal claim by ID. CANONICAL update the status of a legal claim. CANONICAL calculate filing windows for a violation date. Returns deadlines for each claim type. CANONICAL generate a retaliation complaint from tenant and property info. CANONICAL generate a license complaint against a broker. CANONICAL generate a HUD complaint from tenant and property info. CANONICAL list of Minnesota tenant rights attorneys.
